purpose: Prevent the computed-floor engine from becoming a false-zero tool. The controls prove that strict live imports can be counted inside a quarantined test harness while archive examples remain zero-weight until genuine evidence exists. rev0208 adds a correlation-discount control so the engine proves authenticity is not independence.
